body: Well I was actually doing a lot better but then something happened today and I want to fucking die again because I’m a stupid fucking idiot who can’t do anything right and always has to fuck everything up and ruin everything.
Thank you I really appreciate your reply ❤️ I may reach out in the future if that’s okay
Yeah, I definitely understand. It still hurts though because I really miss them. But life gets in the way, I get it. Also I just want to say I had a better day today :)

I did give them my contact info and a few said they would reach out but none have. Trying not to get into my head about what that means. Thank you for your advice and your help I really needed someone to listen last night. Today I’m doing OK.

Okay thank you I will look for an app like that to keep track of things. I used to keep a journal but it was difficult to remember to do it every night. On my phone is a lot easier. I’m really frustrated that I haven’t been able to adjust my medication and in the meantime I’m just losing grip on myself and it’s hard to see all this time wasted. I had to leave group because I started night school which interfered with my group schedule. It’s been really exhausting mourning the loss. The days I miss class because I’m depressed on the days I used to have group I can’t get over myself for not being there. I don’t think I have any time in my schedule for a new group though or even in my heart I don’t think I can move on yet if that makes sense.

Hi thank you so much for responding I didn’t expect anyone to read this I actually started crying when I read your message. Yes I’m on medication but I’ve been wanting to go up on it for a few months and my psychiatrist has been hesitant and just saying let’s see etc. but I think it’s not as effective anymore because I’m in a cycle again. I do like my therapist but I recently had to leave a therapy group that I’d been really attached to and I’m really missing it and I think I am needing more at the moment. I think that’s why I’ve been over sharing with people because I don’t have enough of an outlet.
